name: Chris Maanas
bio:
Chris is always happy and inspired to share his passion for yoga, healing, meditation, and traveling and he is deeply grateful for the opportunity to bring all of these passions together to create one amazing life changing experience.

Based in Miami, co-founder of Fresh Prana Miami.

name: Devi Rajpriti Kaur
facilitatorNames: Devi Rajpriti Kaur|Devi Raj Priti Kaur|Olena Devi Rajpriti Kaur|Olena Devi Kaur
bio: Olena Devi Kaur is a Kundalini Yoga teacher, meditation facilitator, and spiritual wellbeing educator. Trained through KRI, Khalsa Way Prenatal Yoga, and years of immersive practice, she creates transformative experiences centered on consciousness, dignity, devotion, and embodied spiritual growth.

name: Dr Haridass Kaur
facilitatorNames: Dr Haridass Kaur|Dr. Haridass Kaur|Haridass Kaur
bio: Author, Mentoring Teacher Trainer, Entrepreneur, Investor, Speaker and founder of Infinite Goddess School of Human Advancement in Los Angeles where she offers training programs, workshops, as well as online educational programs to teachers, individuals and business professionals.

name: Dyal Gobinde
bio: Kundalini Yoga instructor for 10 years, after a Kundalini awakening 12 years ago. Sadhana practitioner, Level 2 Sat Nam Rasayan, and 60+ days of White Tantric Yoga. He has taught thousands of classes and students in Chicago and around the world.

name: Jot Simrit
bio: Jot Simrit is a KRI Certified Kundalini Yoga instructor, sound facilitator, and meditation guide based in Mallorca.

name: Karuna
bio: Karuna is a teacher of Kundalini Yoga, meditation, and mantra as practical tools for lived transformation and everyday life. A Kundalini Research Institute Associate Level One, Two, and Three Teacher Trainer. Lives in Boulder, CO. Bringing joy, focus, resilience, harmony, healing: yoga, meditation.

name: Khushbir Singh
bio: Khushbir is a Level 3 Teacher, Lead Teacher Trainer, and has practiced and taught Kundalini Yoga since 1992. In Utah’s Salt Lake Valley, he grows a wild vegetable & flower garden shared by happy birds and bees. He plants trees with TreeUtah, plays in the mountains and deserts, and travels for fun.

name: Livtar Singh
bio:
Livtar Singh has been a Kundalini Yoga student and teacher since 1969, when he first met Yogi Bhajan. He is one of the most inspirational songwriters and singers of the Yogic/Khalsa musical heritage. His words combine personal experience with devotion to the love of the ONE. His melodies and voice create a mood of sweetness and beauty.
He is a huge fan of the Solstice experience to achieve permanent spiritual growth.

name: Sat Bir Singh
facilitatorNames: Sat Bir Singh|Sat Bir Singh Khalsa|Dr. Sat Bir Singh
bio: Sat Bir Singh Khalsa, Ph.D. is a Corresponding Member of the Faculty of Medicine at Harvard Medical School, Director of Research for the Kundalini Research Institute, editor-in-chief of the International Journal of Yoga Therapy, and chief editor of The Principles and Practice of Yoga in Health Care.

name: Satwant Singh
bio: Satwant Singh has been practicing and teaching Kundalini Yoga for over 50 years. He serves as Executive Director of the Siri Singh Sahib Corporation and Treasurer of Sikh Dharma of Virginia and 3HO Foundation of Virginia. He provides insights gained from both the Sadhana Room and the Board Room.

name: Sergio Akaal
bio: Sergio began his Kundalini Yoga journey over a decade ago. His dynamic yet heart-centered classes reflect years of devoted practice, including 10+ Tantric days each year, creating an experience designed to awaken and transform you.

name: Siri Simran Kaur
facilitatorNames: Siri Simran Kaur|Siri Simran Khalsa|Siri Simran K.
bio: Siri Simran Khalsa is a Level III Sat Nam Rasayan® healer, and CEO of White Tantric Yoga®. She has devoted over two decades to the meditative healing arts, guiding students to deepen their awareness, strengthen their intuition, and experience the healing power of the meditative mind.
